newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady on Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady on Wall Street.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen steady on Friday after Wall Street's strong gains overnight, while the possibilities of mergers among state banks is likely to boost sentiment on banking stocks, brokers said.
"Reports of possible mergers among state-owned banks and reports that the central bank may soon sell its stake in Bank Papan should boost sentiment on bank stocks," one broker said.
Newspapers quoted Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad as saying that the government was studying the possibility of mergers among state-owned banks.
The Dow Jones industrial average surged 135.64 points to a record high of 7,711.47 on Thursday.
On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index closed 2.18 points higher at 695.22 points.
Second-liners property firm Mas Murni and tourism services firm Bayu Buana made modest gains in active trading due to market talk of possible take-overs.
Brokers said the market was likely to stay steady the rest of the day, with banking stocks remaining among the most actives.
